hikes.name: Indian Sands
hikes.blurb: A short walk to wind-sculpted sandstone and dunes high on a bluff over the sea.

hikes.name: Humbug Mountain
hikes.blurb: Through myrtlewood and old fir up one of the tallest mountains rising straight from the Oregon surf.

hikes.name: Illinois River Trail to Buzzards Roost
hikes.blurb: A climb above the wild Illinois River canyon to a rock outcrop with a long view up the gorge.

hikes.name: Cape Ferrelo
hikes.blurb: Down a grassy headland to a sheltered cove of tide pools and sea stacks.

hikes.name: Cape Sebastian
hikes.blurb: Out a high headland through spruce to the cape's tip, the coast running south toward California.

hikes.name: Pearsoll Peak
hikes.blurb: From Fall Creek Trailhead, a 13.5-mile round trip to the top of Pearsoll Peak (4,720 ft), with about 4,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Illinois River Falls
hikes.blurb: From Eight Dollar Mountain Botanical Wayside, a 3.4-mile round trip to Little Illinois River Falls, with about 550 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Onion Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Shan Creek Trail, an 11.4-mile round trip to the top of Onion Mountain (4,449 ft), with about 2,900 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Stair Creek Falls
hikes.blurb: From Marial Trailhead, a 2.7-mile round trip to Stair Creek Falls, with about 300 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Vulcan Lake
hikes.blurb: From Vulcan Lake Trailhead, a 2.9-mile round trip to Vulcan Lake, with about 750 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Eagle Mountain
hikes.blurb: From Kalmiopsis Rim Trailhead, a 5.3-mile round trip to the top of Eagle Mountain (4,372 ft), with about 1,650 feet of climbing.
